Peers may post insurance against an identity's behaviour and collect 12% of its slashed stake when it misbehaves, creating a market that profits from finding fraud. A farm therefore faces counterparties who are paid to expose it, which is cheaper to run than any central monitor. Every extra alias adds 6 hours of verification and 28 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
